steps.why: A window on the X server DISPLAY names, the library linked over Xlib: Dolly's own DISPLAY names none, and opening says so.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <x11-window.h>' '#include <errno.h>' 'int main(void) { return x11_window_open("amy", 64, 48) != NULL || errno != ENOENT; }' > /tmp/amy-x11.c && cc -O0 /tmp/amy-x11.c -lx11-window -lX11 -lxcb -lXau -ldolly-sockets -o /tmp/amy-x11 && /tmp/amy-x11
